why: The README's very first and primary documented usage is wrapping an iterable with `tqdm(iterable)` (and the "Iterable-based" Usage section's `for char in tqdm(["a","b","c","d"])` example with `set_description`), so this script follows one data journey through `tqdm.std.tqdm.__init__`/`__iter__`/`update`/`display`/`close` and asserts the accumulated result and completed counter.
